end.summary:
- Practised identifying paper tearing as a physical change and sparkler burning and milk curdling as chemical changes.
- Practised telling melting apart from dissolving using chocolate, sugar and salt in water.
- Recognised that dissolved sugar or salt is still present because the water tastes sweet or salty.
- The melting-versus-dissolving mix-up remained at the end; this needs checking again next time.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised classifying changes using examples such as torn paper, a burning sparkler and curdling milk. They used taste to notice that dissolved sugar or salt is still present, but continued to call dissolving “melting” by the end, so this distinction still needs practice. At home, try sorting examples into two groups: “changes shape or state” and “mixes into a liquid but remains present,” then ask Ananya to explain one example from each.

turns.text: sparkler wala chemical hai kya? par, wait, mummy ne kal curd banaya tha doodh garam karke, toh woh bhi toh change tha, lekin phir mummy ne kaha fridge mein rakhne par wapas doodh nahi ban sakta, par maine suna hai ki... haan woh toh waapis aa sakta hai na? jaise anda ubalne par solid ho jaata hai, thanda karo toh raw ho jayega, toh sparkler bhi thanda karoge toh waapis sparkler ban jayega, toh don

Sparkler chemical badlav hai, aur aapne doodh aur ande par achha sawaal uthaya. Doodh se dahi banne par thanda karke doodh wapas nahi milta; ubla anda bhi thanda hokar kaccha nahi banta. Poster kaatne aur sparkler jalne mein naya padarth banne ka fark kya hai?
sparkler jalana chemical hai, kyunki... usmein naya... kuch ban gaya, sparks aur rakh jaise, woh poster ke tukde toh ab bhi poster hi hain, lekin sparkler toh... jal gaya na?

Haan, sparkler jalne par raakh jaisa naya padarth banta hai, jabki poster ke tukde kaagaz hi rehte hain. Aapne naya padarth wala fark bataya; ab ek aur situation mein use lagate hain. Garmi mein doodh khatta hokar phat jaaye, toh woh physical badlav hai ya chemical, aur aapko kya saboot milega?

chemical change hai, kyunki woh khatta smell aata hai na, aur taste bhi alag ho jaata hai, aur doodh phat jaata hai matlab lumps ban jaate hain, phir wapas fresh doodh nahi ban sakta, jaise mummy ne kal kaha tha curd ke liye bhi

Haan, aapne khatti smell, badla taste aur lumps ko saboot bataya; ye naye padarth ke sanket hain. Fresh doodh wapas na milna ek clue hai, par faisla naye padarth se hota hai. Ab sochiye: namak paani mein milane ko pighalna bolenge ya ghulna, aur dono mein kya fark hai?
pighalna... matlab, namak paani mein daala toh woh gayab ho gaya na, jaise ice cream pighalti hai, dikhta nahi but woh hai andar, toh pighalna hi bolna chahiye

Aap keh rahe hain namak dikhta nahi, isliye pighal gaya. Par ice cream bina paani milaye liquid hoti hai; namak paani mein milkar ghulta hai, aur namak wahin rehta hai. Agar paani sukh jaaye, toh namak ka kya hoga?
haan toh... namak paani mein mil gaya, dikhta nahi, toh pighal gaya na, like, ice cream bhi toh dikhti nahi jab pighalti hai, liquid ho jaati hai, same hi hai, pighalna hi bolna chahiye

Aap keh rahe hain ki namak na dikhne ka matlab woh pighal gaya. Ek fark sochiye: ice cream ko liquid banne ke liye paani mein milana zaroori nahi, lekin namak paani mein failta hai; isse ghulna kehte hain. Ab ek chhota test: cheeni paani mein ghulne ke baad na dikhe, toh glass ka wazan badhega, utna hi rahega ya ghatega?
badhega, cheeni daali na toh wazan badhega hi, haan, jaise chai mein cheeni daalte hain toh meetha ho jaata hai, dikhti nahi but hai toh andar hi

Haan, wazan badhega: cheeni dikhna band hui, par glass mein hai, aur chai ka meetha swaad bhi uska saboot hai. Ab ek kadam aage: room-temperature paani mein cheeni milana aur chocolate garam karke liquid banana, inmein kaunsa ghulna hai aur kaunsa pighalna?
chocolate wala toh pighal raha hai na, kyunki garam kiya, aur sugar wala... sugar daal diya paani mein, woh bhi pighal gaya, dono same hai, jaise ice cream pighalti hai

Aap keh rahe hain dono pighle, kyunki cheeni bhi dikhni band ho gayi. Chocolate ko sirf garam karo, toh woh liquid banti hai; cheeni ko room-temperature paani mein mila rahe hain, isliye woh ghulti hai, pighalti nahi. Ab ek naya case: chocolate ko bina paani milaye garam karein, toh use ghulna kahenge ya pighalna?
chocolate wala pighalna hai, aur sugar wala... sugar daala na, toh woh pighal gaya, aur haan woh ab bhi hai, kyunki meetha ho gaya paani, dikhta nahi hai lekin hai

Aapne sahi pakda ki garam chocolate pighalti hai aur cheeni paani mein ab bhi rehti hai. Aap cheeni ko pighalna keh rahe hain, lekin chocolate bina paani ke liquid banti hai; cheeni room-temperature paani mein milkar failti hai, isliye use ghulna kehte hain. Ab sirf ek fark batayein: chocolate ko liquid banane ke liye paani chahiye ya garmi?

chocolate ke liye garmi chahiye, aur sugar wala... dissolving kisne kiya? hmm... chocolate wala kyunki woh liquid ban gaya, aur sugar wala pighal gaya, toh dissolving nahi kiya, aur sugar abhi bhi hai because meetha paani hai, but dikhne mein toh woh gayab hai, toh... pata nahi, shayad chocolate wala dissolving hai?

Cheeni paani mein ab bhi hai; meetha swaad uska saboot hai. Aap chocolate ko dissolving keh rahe hain kyunki woh liquid bani. Par usmein paani milaya hi nahi: sirf garam hokar pighli. Cheeni paani mein faili, isliye ghuli. Agar cheeni ki jagah namak room-temperature paani mein milaayein, toh use ghulna kahenge ya pighalna?

namak wala bhi pighal gaya hoga na, room-temperature paani mein mila toh woh bhi dikhna band ho gaya, jaise sugar, toh pighalna hi bolenge, dissolving toh... chocolate wala hi kiya, kyunki woh garam karke liquid bana, haan

Aap keh rahe hain namak dikhna band hua, isliye pighla; aur chocolate liquid bani, isliye dissolve hui. Ek alag misaal: dance mein aap bheed ke beech jaakar dikhna band ho jaayein, toh aap liquid nahi ban jaate. Namak paani mein failta hai, isliye ghulta hai; chocolate bina paani ke garam hokar liquid banti hai, isliye pighalti hai. Agar barf bina paani milaye liquid ban jaaye, toh use ghulna kahenge ya pighalna?
barf bina paani ke liquid bani toh... woh pighalna hoga na, aur dissolving wali cheez... chocolate ne kiya, kyuki woh garam karke liquid ban gaya, haan, chocolate dissolving kiya

Barf ka liquid banna pighalna hai. Aap chocolate ko dissolving keh rahe hain kyunki woh liquid bani; lekin usmein paani mila hi nahi, sirf garmi mili. Jab koi cheez paani mein milkar failti hai, jaise cheeni, use ghulna kehte hain. Chocolate ke case mein paani milaya tha ya sirf garam kiya tha?
chocolate ne dissolving kiya, kyunki woh garam karke liquid ban gaya, aur sugar... sugar ab bhi hai kyunki paani meetha ho gaya, but usne dissolving nahi kiya, woh toh bas pighal gaya

Aap keh rahe hain chocolate liquid bani, isliye ghuli, aur cheeni paani mein daalne par pighli. Ek chhota rule try karein: pighalne mein garmi se wahi cheez liquid banti hai; ghulne mein woh paani ke andar failti hai. Room-temperature paani mein cheeni daali thi, chocolate mein paani nahi daala tha. Is rule se cheeni ke saath kya hua?
